parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $BD=5\sin(\text{their }0.8)$. — M1. Guidance: Expect 3.58(7). Methods using degrees are acceptable. $DC=5-5\cos(\text{their }0.8)$. — M1. Guidance: Expect 1.51(6). Sector $=\frac12\times5^2\times\text{their }0.8$, OR segment $=\frac12\times5^2[\text{their }0.8-\sin(\text{their }0.8)]$. — M1. Guidance: Expect 10 for sector; expect 1.03(3) for segment. Trapezium $=\frac12(5+\text{their }DC)\times\text{their }BD$ oe, OR $\triangle BDC=\frac12\text{their }BD\times\text{their }CD$. — M1. Shaded area $=11.69-10$ OR $2.71(9)-1.03(3)=1.69$ cao. — A1. Alternative for the last 2 marks: if $X$ is on $AB$ and $XC$ is parallel to $BD$, $BDCX-(\text{sector}-\triangle AXC)=5.43(8)-[10-6.24(9)]=1.69$ cao — M1A1. Total 5.
